name: Unitree Go2
description: Unitree's mainstream quadruped robot dog, shipping across four tiers (Air / Pro / X / EDU) with chin-mounted 4D LiDAR, autonomous obstacle avoidance, and an app-based control ecosystem. The EDU tier adds full SDK access and an optional Jetson Orin module for custom development.

specs.label: Max Speed
specs.note: EDU tier; Air 2.5 m/s, Pro 3.5 m/s

pricing.summary: From $1,600 (Go2 Air). Go2 Pro is $2,800, Go2 X is $4,500, and Go2 EDU (full SDK access, force-sensor feet, optional Jetson Orin module) is contact-for-price — Unitree does not list it publicly. See the tier comparison below; specs and features vary meaningfully by tier, so treat any single quoted price or spec as tier-specific.

tiers.notes: Base config — no 4G, no follow-me mode, 6-month warranty
Adds 4G module, ISS 2.0 follow-me mode, voice function, 12-month warranty
Full developer SDK, force-sensor feet, optional Jetson Orin (40–100 TOPS)

editorial.heading: Sensors & Hardware
editorial.body: All standard tiers ship with Unitree's chin-mounted 4D LiDAR — called "L1" in Unitree's original 2023 launch materials and "L2" on current shop.unitree.com listings, most likely an updated unit on later production runs rather than two separate products — giving 360°×90–96° hemispherical coverage down to a 0.05 m minimum range for real-time obstacle avoidance and 3D mapping. It pairs with a custom HD wide-angle camera system (exact camera count undisclosed) and an onboard mic supporting offline voice-assistant commands. Compute is an 8-core CPU on Pro/X/EDU versus more basic onboard computing on Air; EDU alone supports bolting on an external NVIDIA Jetson Orin module for custom AI workloads and full SDK development. Notable capabilities include a high-speed "Rage Mode" gait, adaptive/inverted gaits, climbing steps of roughly 15–16 cm and 30–40° slopes (tier-dependent), and app-based teleoperation and monitoring.

sourcing: Specs sourced from Unitree's official product and shop pages (unitree.com/go2, shop.unitree.com), Unitree's original July 2023 launch release, and IEEE Spectrum's tier-by-tier coverage, as of September 2026. Max speed, payload, connectivity, and compute vary by tier — figures above reflect the specific tier noted, not a single universal spec. Go2 EDU has no public price; contact Unitree sales directly. robotindex does not sell this product.
